name: check_room
description: Checks whether one room can be booked for a requested time slot on the same day and answers Available or Unavailable. Every time is a whole number of minutes since midnight, from 0 to 1440 (10:00 = 600, 24:00 = 1440). This tool does not save, create or change a booking: it only checks.

start.description: Requested start, in minutes since midnight (10:00 = 600).

end.description: Requested end, in minutes since midnight (24:00 = 1440).

now.description: The current time, in minutes since midnight.

blocked.description: true if the room is blocked (for example for maintenance), otherwise false.

bookings.description: Existing bookings of the room today. Use an empty list if there are none.
